name: Poligraph MCP
author: ironlam
description: Query documented French political data about politicians, mandates, parliamentary votes, parties, elections, public affairs, and fact-checks.

installation.notes: Users can connect directly to the hosted endpoint with complete Claude Desktop or Claude Code steps; clone, dependency, build, and stdio client instructions are also provided for local use.

configuration.notes: Hosted use has a complete URL configuration and explicitly relies only on the public API without a service key; the optional exact-origin allowlist and localhost defaults are documented.

tools.notes: All 19 tools are organized and described across political, parliamentary, electoral, judicial, and fact-checking domains, but no concrete natural-language MCP prompt is included.

compatibility.notes: Streamable HTTP and stdio transports are explicitly named, and the hosted transport has concrete configurations for Claude Desktop and Claude Code.

license.notes: The README and package metadata declare MIT, but the reviewed repository contains no license file or linked terms applying that license to the server code.

limitations.notes: The documentation explains strict Origin handling and its allowlist workaround, read-only public-API scope, judicial-role semantics, and fail-safe treatment of incomplete data.
